== Players Committee forum (forum.starwarsccg.org) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page from the live Players Committee forum. Sources used: topics 19214 (posts 269148, 269536, 299372, 299380, 301014, 301099, 301685, 307254), 21635 (post 311852), 15832 (post 216444).
=== Identification ===
* The winner is posted only as "Angelo". Linked to [[Angelo Consoli]] under the small-world rule: Gravityshadow (his GEMP handle per his wiki page) wrote that he and Chris had submitted tournament reports for this event, signs "Angelo" in the Norwegian Open topic (20492/307224), and won the [[2008 Norwegian Open]] four weeks later.
* "Euremperor" in Roken's post = [[Chris Menzel]], who signs "Chris (Euro Emperor) Menzel" (15832/216444) and was 5th.
* The organizer "Chris" who moved the date is not identified further in the topic.
